snippet.title: Gakuen Tokusou Bakushion (学園特捜バクシオン) (longplay) for the NEC PC-88
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

---


Game description:

Gakuen Tokusou Bakushion is a Japanese-style adventure game and turn-based fighting game.

You are a high school student who got transferred to another high school.
You can transform into a Super Sentai-style hero when you have to fight villains or transformed friends.
